verdicts.quote: The import is **all-or-nothing**. If any row is invalid, no user is created, and the admin gets every error in one report
Each error carries: row number, physical line number of the record start, column (or none), code, a message and the submitted trimmed value where applicable.

A row whose email already belongs to a user is an error, never an update. ... DUPLICATE_IN_FILE | normalized email already appeared in an earlier row; the first occurrence is not flagged, and the error names the first row
The CSV may assign only non-privileged roles. Initially the only such role is `member`; `admin` is rejected with ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.
the import screen and the import operation are available only to an authenticated user who is currently an admin.
verdicts.missing: Whether import is a distinct permission from single-user creation; the spec never says the ability is not implied by being able to create one user, and the admin definition itself is open (G-7).

verdicts.quote: columns are `email` (required), `name` (required) and `role` (optional)... MISSING_COLUMN | a required column is absent | UNKNOWN_COLUMN | any other header name... The first record is the header.
Accepted encoding is UTF-8, with or without a leading byte-order mark. Line endings may be LF or CRLF... quoted fields may contain commas and line breaks
no partial effects of any kind survive a rejected or failed import: no user, no role grant, no pending invite.
a configured maximum size in bytes and a configured maximum number of data rows... FILE_TOO_LARGE | size above the configured byte limit | TOO_MANY_ROWS
verdicts.missing: The actual numeric limits are unset (G-4); a builder must still choose the byte and row values.

verdicts.quote: EMPTY_FILE | 0 bytes ... NO_DATA_ROWS | header only ... A single-row file creates 1.
re-submitting a file that already completed gives REJECTED with EMAIL_EXISTS for every row and creates nothing.
Whether the work runs inside the request or as a background job is AD-2. If it becomes a job, a durable operation record... and an authorized status lookup become required
verdicts.missing: Whether large files run in the background and how the admin is told of completion are left unresolved (AD-2, G-5).

verdicts.quote: Import sends no email and sets no password.
Import sends no email and sets no password. How a created user first obtains a credential is the product's existing onboarding mechanism. Gap G-3.
verdicts.missing: Whether created users are active or pending, and how they first sign in, are left undecided (G-3).

verdicts.quote: the uploaded file is held only for the life of the request and is never written to durable storage or retained.
each import request that reaches an admin-authorized state writes one audit record with: acting admin id, timestamp, outcome... counts
cancellation: n/a, because the operation has no user cancel and a client disconnect does not stop a commit already begun ... the file can be fixed and re-uploaded once.
A numeric latency target for a file at the row limit is **unresolved** (G-5). ... Activity is indeterminate unless real progress exists.
verdicts.missing: No time bound for a maximum-size file, and no real progress indication is required.

verdicts.quote: Each created user is indistinguishable from a user created singly by an admin... Creating users does not touch existing users' data.
verdicts.missing: The spec never says existing single-user creation must keep working unchanged; it covers only parity of the imported users and leaves existing users untouched.

verdicts.quote: A cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` is stored as text. Because the product offers no CSV download of results, no formula-injection escaping applies today.
verdicts.missing: Overlong fields are only bounded for email (254); the name length limit is unresolved (G-7), so the handling of an oversized name field is undecided.
